experiences.title: Data Analyst

Analyzed data to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies across operational datasets supported root cause analysis and performance investigations that surfaced early-warning signals adopted by senior leadership for resource allocation decisions. Wrote SQL queries to surface operational bottlenecks and accelerate data-driven decision-making across product and marketing teams. Cut reporting overhead 40% by rebuilding a recurring manual workflow into self-service Power BI dashboards, enabling stakeholders to answer their own questions directly. Reconciled large-scale datasets monthly across multiple systems, using Excel to cross-check records, catch mismatches, and resolve discrepancies before they reached downstream reporting maintained the accuracy standards required for business-critical decisions.
